lines.zh: 苔藓壳还软，我走得摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: My mossy shell is still soft, so I waddle.

lines.zh: 每一步都带下一点绿苔，像撒种子。
lines.en: Every step sheds a little green moss, like sowing seed.

lines.zh: 我跟着大犰狳的脚印，从不走偏。
lines.en: I follow the big armadillo's prints and never stray.

lines.zh: 短腿蹬着湿土，壳上的苔在晃。
lines.en: Short legs push wet soil, the moss on my shell swaying.

lines.zh: 我绕开石子，怕磕坏刚长的苔。
lines.en: I step around stones so the new moss stays whole.

lines.zh: 草地太深，我只露出半只壳。
lines.en: The grass is too deep; only half my shell shows.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，苔藓喜欢阴凉。
lines.en: I hug the wall's foot, where moss likes the shade.

lines.zh: 走到哪儿，身后就多一条绿痕。
lines.en: Wherever I go, a green trail stays behind me.

lines.zh: 我第一次出洞，世界比壳大得多。
lines.en: My first time out of the burrow; the world dwarfs my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，壳里已经积了雨水。
lines.en: I inch along, rain already pooled inside my shell.

lines.zh: 落叶盖上来，我成了会走的一团苔。
lines.en: Leaves fall on me and I become a walking clump of moss.

lines.zh: 我边走边嗅，找能蹭上身的湿苔。
lines.en: I sniff as I walk, hunting damp moss to rub on.

lines.zh: 我缩成一小团，只在壳缝里透气。
lines.en: I curl into a small ball, breathing through a shell gap.

lines.zh: 苔藓在我背上慢慢长，我等着。
lines.en: Moss grows slowly on my back, and I wait for it.

lines.zh: 我把鼻尖埋进土里，听蚯蚓翻身。
lines.en: I bury my snout in soil and listen to worms turning.

lines.zh: 太阳晒到壳上，暖得像母亲腹部。
lines.en: Sun on my shell feels as warm as my mother's belly.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，鸟儿差点落在我背上。
lines.en: I hold still, and a bird nearly lands on my back.

lines.zh: 壳里的水凉了，我抖一下再缩回。
lines.en: The water in my shell cools; I shiver and tuck in.

lines.zh: 我数着从叶尖滴下的水珠。
lines.en: I count the drops falling from the leaf tips.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，苔藓替我呼吸。
lines.en: I close my eyes and let the moss breathe for me.

lines.zh: 有人经过，我屏住气装成石头。
lines.en: Someone passes; I hold my breath and play stone.

lines.zh: 我打了个小嗝，苔味散开一点。
lines.en: I give a tiny burp and a mossy smell escapes.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收进壳，只留一道缝。
lines.en: I pull my claws in, leaving only a slit open.

lines.zh: 风翻动落叶，我以为是脚步声。
lines.en: Wind turns the leaves and I mistake it for footsteps.

lines.zh: 我懒得很，苔藓比我勤快。
lines.en: I am lazy; the moss is far more industrious than me.

lines.zh: 壳上冒出一根小芽，我没敢动。
lines.en: A sprout pushes out of my shell, so I dare not move.

lines.zh: 我把自己滚成球，滚到石头缝里。
lines.en: I roll myself into a ball and into a crack in the rocks.

lines.zh: 壳上的苔被我蹭掉了一块，我心疼。
lines.en: I scraped off a patch of moss and I mourn it.

lines.zh: 我学着母亲那样，慢慢挖土。
lines.en: I dig slowly, the way my mother does.

lines.zh: 一只蜗牛爬过我的爪，我没动。
lines.en: A snail crosses my claw and I stay still.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛比鼻子还小。
lines.en: I look up at you with eyes smaller than my nose.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来时，我正好到你鞋边。
lines.en: When you crouch, I am exactly at your shoe.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，猜你手里有没有苔。
lines.en: I tilt my head, guessing whether your hands hold moss.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩住我，我缩了半寸。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and I shrink half an inch.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，才眨一次眼。
lines.en: I study your face a long while before blinking.

lines.zh: 你身上没有土味，我有点失望。
lines.en: You smell of no soil at all, which disappoints me.

lines.zh: 我从壳缝里望你，不敢全露头。
lines.en: I peer at you through my shell gap, not fully out.

lines.zh: 你呼气时，我的鼻尖跟着动了动。
lines.en: When you breathe out, my snout twitches.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，那里沾着草屑。
lines.en: I stare at your boots; grass bits cling to them.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我以为要摸我的壳。
lines.en: You raise a hand and I think you will touch my shell.

lines.zh: 我伸出一只爪，又缩了回去。
lines.en: I reach out one claw, then pull it back in.

lines.zh: 你站得太高，我要仰到壳发酸。
lines.en: You stand too tall; my shell aches from looking up.

lines.zh: 壳被敲了一下，我滚了出去。
lines.en: My shell takes a knock and I roll away.

lines.zh: 我疼得叫，声音小得没人听见。
lines.en: I cry in pain, too quietly for anyone to hear.

lines.zh: 苔藓掉了一块，露出粉色的皮。
lines.en: A patch of moss falls off, showing pink skin.

lines.zh: 我团成球，可你还没停手。
lines.en: I ball myself up, but you have not stopped.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，里面还是软软的肉。
lines.en: My shell cracks; the flesh inside is still soft.

lines.zh: 我翻不了身，四只爪在空中乱抓。
lines.en: I cannot right myself; four claws scrabble at air.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打进草里，我尝到泥。
lines.en: The blow knocks me into the grass and I taste mud.

lines.zh: 我缩到最紧，希望你看不见我。
lines.en: I curl as tight as I can, hoping you lose sight of me.

lines.zh: 雨从破口滴进来，冷得发抖。
lines.en: Rain drips through the crack and I shiver.

lines.zh: 我哭起来，像幼崽该做的那样。
lines.en: I start to cry, the way a young one should.

lines.zh: 你手里那片苔，让我忘了害怕。
lines.en: That patch of moss in your hand makes me forget fear.

lines.zh: 我闻到了湿土和嫩根的味道。
lines.en: I smell wet soil and tender roots.

lines.zh: 你蹲低些，我脖子短，够不到。
lines.en: Crouch lower; my neck is short and cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我往前挪半步，壳还是缩着的。
lines.en: I shuffle half a step forward, shell still shut.

lines.zh: 是苔吗？我只认这个味道。
lines.en: Is it moss? That is the only smell I know.

lines.zh: 你晃动手掌，我眼睛跟着转。
lines.en: You wave your palm and my eyes follow it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴了，牙还没长齐。
lines.en: I open my mouth, though my teeth are not all in.

lines.zh: 你要喂我，得先把土抖掉。
lines.en: If you feed me, shake the dirt off first.

lines.zh: 我馋，可我得先闻一闻。
lines.en: I am greedy, but I must sniff it first.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我追两步，然后装作路过。
lines.en: You take a step, I take two, then pretend I just passed by.

lines.zh: 你脚碰到我的壳，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: Your foot taps my shell and I roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 我撞上你小腿，像撞上一堵湿墙。
lines.en: I bump your shin like hitting a damp wall.

lines.zh: 壳太圆，我一碰就歪向一边。
lines.en: My shell is too round; one touch tips me sideways.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的苔，我吱了一声。
lines.en: You step on my moss and I squeak once.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你裤脚，留下一道绿。
lines.en: I brush your trouser leg and leave a green streak.

lines.zh: 别推，我壳里还存着雨水。
lines.en: Do not push; rainwater is still stored in my shell.

lines.zh: 我被挤得翻了身，四只爪乱蹬。
lines.en: Squeezed, I flip over and paddle four claws at air.

lines.zh: 你挡住我，我就绕，反正慢。
lines.en: You block me, so I go around; I am slow anyway.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的靴子，弹回草里。
lines.en: I hit your boot and bounce back into the grass.

lines.zh: 苔藓蹭掉了，我回头看一眼。
lines.en: The moss rubbed off; I glance back at it once.

lines.zh: 我还太小，只想和兄弟挤在一起。
lines.en: I am too young; I only want to huddle with my brothers.

lines.zh: 两只幼崽的壳碰在一起，咯咯响。
lines.en: Two young shells knock together with a clack.

lines.zh: 我们互相蹭苔，把绿分给对方。
lines.en: We rub moss on each other, sharing the green.

lines.zh: 它钻到我壳下，我们叠成一堆。
lines.en: It crawls under my shell and we stack into a pile.

lines.zh: 我们跟着母亲，尾巴碰尾巴。
lines.en: We trail our mother, tail touching tail.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖碰它的鼻尖，闻闻是不是同类。
lines.en: I touch my snout to its snout to smell if it is kin.

lines.zh: 同窝的伙伴把湿苔盖到我背上。
lines.en: A littermate drapes wet moss over my back.

lines.zh: 我们挤在洞里，谁的壳都不是自己的。
lines.en: Packed in the burrow, none of our shells feels our own.

lines.zh: 它推我一下，我滚进落叶堆。
lines.en: It shoves me and I roll into the leaf pile.

lines.zh: 等壳硬了，我们才各自出门。
lines.en: Only when our shells harden will we leave separately.

lines.zh: 我没手，掉了的东西只能看着。
lines.en: I have no hands; dropped things I can only watch.

lines.zh: 我用爪子扒拉，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: I paw at it and grasp nothing at all.

lines.zh: 掉在我脚边的苔，我会趴下去吃。
lines.en: Moss dropped by my feet, I lie down and eat.

lines.zh: 你扔下的东西，我闻闻就走开。
lines.en: Things you toss, I sniff and then walk away.

lines.zh: 我试着叼，嘴里太小，掉了。
lines.en: I try to carry it, but my mouth is too small.

lines.zh: 壳太宽，我弯不下腰去捡。
lines.en: My shell is too wide for me to bend and pick up.

lines.zh: 我只会把落叶推着走。
lines.en: All I can do is push fallen leaves along.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，我推回洞里。
lines.en: A fallen berry I push back to the burrow.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，就用鼻子拱。
lines.en: I cannot lift it, so I root it with my nose.

lines.zh: 有壳挡着，我看不见脚底的东西。
lines.en: My shell blocks the view of anything under my feet.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近我的洞，我先缩紧。
lines.en: Something nears my burrow, so I tighten up first.

lines.zh: 我听见草动，壳已经转过去了。
lines.en: I hear grass move and my shell has already turned.

lines.zh: 比我大的都可怕，我先盯住它。
lines.en: Anything bigger is frightening, so I fix my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 那只甲虫爬过来，我决定不退。
lines.en: That beetle crawls closer and I decide not to retreat.

lines.zh: 有影子落下来，我立刻绷住壳。
lines.en: A shadow falls and I brace my shell at once.

lines.zh: 它闻起来不像苔，我警惕了。
lines.en: It does not smell like moss, so I grow wary.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个洞，怕里面有蛇。
lines.en: I stare at that hole, afraid a snake is inside.

lines.zh: 妈妈不在，我得自己看着门口。
lines.en: Mother is away, so I must watch the entrance alone.

lines.zh: 我冲过去半步，然后停住。
lines.en: I lunge half a step, then stop dead.

lines.zh: 有爪子声，我转身，壳朝外。
lines.en: Claws scrape; I turn with my shell facing out.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，让壳先对着它。
lines.en: I crouch low and point my shell at it.

lines.zh: 我绕圈，苔藓在地上拖出一条线。
lines.en: I circle, dragging a line of moss on the ground.

lines.zh: 它动一下，我的爪就往土里抓。
lines.en: It moves once and my claws dig into the soil.

lines.zh: 我嘶一声，声音细得像漏气。
lines.en: I hiss, a thin sound like escaping air.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只把壳抬起来威慑。
lines.en: I make no cry; I only lift my shell to threaten.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的脚，怕被踩到。
lines.en: I watch its feet, afraid of being stepped on.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，绝不先扑。
lines.en: I shift one step at a time and never pounce first.

lines.zh: 壳边蹭出泥，我准备滚过去。
lines.en: Mud scrapes off my shell rim; I ready a roll.

lines.zh: 它要是再靠，我就团成球。
lines.en: If it comes closer, I will ball myself up.

lines.zh: 我喘得很快，苔都在抖。
lines.en: My breathing races and the moss trembles.

lines.zh: 我整只撞过去，像块湿的石头。
lines.en: I ram with my whole body like a wet stone.

lines.zh: 我用壳顶它，牙咬不穿就别咬。
lines.en: I butt with my shell; no use biting what teeth cannot pierce.

lines.zh: 我滚进它腿间，再乱蹬一通。
lines.en: I roll between its legs and kick wildly.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可我的苔很滑。
lines.en: The blow is light, but my moss is slick.

lines.zh: 我咬住又松开，嘴太小了。
lines.en: I bite and let go; my mouth is far too small.

lines.zh: 我撞完就缩，等它先动。
lines.en: After ramming I tuck in and wait for it to move.

lines.zh: 壳砸在它脚背上，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: My shell lands on its foot with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我翻倒了，只好用背去顶。
lines.en: I topple over, so I push with my back instead.

lines.zh: 我学着母亲的样子冲，撞歪了。
lines.en: I charge as my mother does, and miss badly.

lines.zh: 它踩住我，我把苔糊了它一脚。
lines.en: It pins me, so I smear moss over its foot.

lines.zh: 我从刷怪蛋里出来，壳上带着露水。
lines.en: I come out of the spawn egg with dew on my shell.

lines.zh: 睁开眼就是一地苔，我以为到家了。
lines.en: I open my eyes to moss everywhere and think I am home.

lines.zh: 我生得比苔藓还小，风一吹就晃。
lines.en: I am born smaller than moss and sway in any breeze.

lines.zh: 洞外很亮，我把头缩了一半。
lines.en: Outside is bright, so I pull my head halfway in.

lines.zh: 母亲不在，只有我的壳和湿土。
lines.en: Mother is gone; only my shell and wet soil remain.

lines.zh: 我落地时翻了身，自己爬正。
lines.en: I land upside down and right myself alone.

lines.zh: 我出生就带着苔，像穿旧衣服。
lines.en: I am born wearing moss like handed-down clothes.

lines.zh: 这里没有大犰狳，我得自己找洞。
lines.en: No big armadillo here; I must find my own burrow.

lines.zh: 我刚站稳，先闻了闻地面。
lines.en: Barely steady, I sniff the ground first.

lines.zh: 壳还没硬透，我走得像喝醉。
lines.en: My shell is not set; I walk as if drunk.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，抖了抖背。
lines.en: I push up out of the soil and shake my back.

lines.zh: 第一口气是湿的，我记住了。
lines.en: My first breath is damp, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 火一烧，壳上的苔立刻卷起来。
lines.en: Fire touches me and the moss on my shell curls at once.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下去，苔都掉光了。
lines.en: Rolling down the slope, I lose all my moss.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，我沉得像块石头。
lines.en: Water fills my shell and I sink like a stone.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀翻，壳嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and my shell rings.

lines.zh: 箭插进壳缝，卡在长苔的地方。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shell gap, stuck in the moss.

lines.zh: 魔法光钻进壳里，我的芽蔫了。
lines.en: Magic light seeps into my shell and my sprout wilts.

lines.zh: 我饿得舔壳上的苔，越舔越空。
lines.en: I lick the moss off my shell and grow hungrier.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，苔焦成一小片黑。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the moss burns to a black patch.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的壳还缩着。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my shell stays curled.
